_comment: Timed events online, the same for everyone. Each weekly event starts on a day of the week (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday) at an hour in UTC and lasts `hours`. Effects: baron_loot multiplies what robber baron camps drop. An event with `invasion` puts invader camps near every castle while it runs: `camps` of them (named from `names`), the first at level 1 + `level_per_keep` per keep level above 1 and each next one a level higher. Every win raises an invader camp a level and gives `points_per_level` event points for each level it had; a beaten camp rebuilds for `rebuild` seconds. `rewards` are the invasion's reward tiers: reach a tier's points to claim its resources and soldiers, in order, until the next invasion starts (resources fill your storage; what doesn't fit is lost). An event with `horde` is the Ember Horde: while it runs, its `camps` stand near every castle (the first at level 1 + `level_per_keep` per keep level above 1, the others `level` higher; where there's room for fewer, the Warlord's camp comes first). Each win raises the camp a level and gives `points` horde points and `trophies` war trophies per level it had, as long as the battle is fought before the event ends. War trophies buy what the Trophy Market (`market`) sells, each item `stock` times per horde. When the horde has gone, every player with points claims one ranked prize: the first of `prizes` whose `up_to` their rank reaches (0: any rank). Trophies, purchases and prizes last until the next horde arrives. The horde's soldiers are in data/horde.json. An event with `boss` is the Warlord's Stronghold, for alliances: while it runs, the stronghold stands near the castle of every member who was in their alliance when it began, at level `level` + `level_per_keep` per keep level above 1 (its soldiers are in data/stronghold.json). It never rises a level; after a win its garrison rallies for `rally` seconds. Every defender slain there, win or lose, wears down the warlord's host, which the whole alliance shares: `host_base` + `host_per_member` soldiers for each member, and `host_growth` times as many after each fall. Each time the host is worn down the stronghold falls, and every member who slew at least `min_damage` claims that fall's chest from `falls`, in order (it can fall once for each chest). `rewards` are your own tiers by defenders slain. Chests and rewards last until the next stronghold rises.

weekly.name: Baron Invasion
weekly.description: Invader camps have appeared near your castle. Beat them for event points.

weekly.name: Ember Horde
weekly.description: Riders of the Ember Horde have made camp near your castle. Beat them for horde points and war trophies.

weekly.name: The Warlord's Stronghold
weekly.description: Warlord Garrak has raised a stronghold. Storm it with your alliance: every defender slain wears down his host.
